guides.name: MrRosaPony PVE&PVP Ultimate Cleric Guide — mrrosapony
guides.description:
Билд с Questlog: №1 по популярности у класса (1184 лайков), автор mrrosapony. Стадий: 3 — выберите целевую.

Описание автора:
Yo welcome MMO-Enjoyers,
I played over 1.000 hours of Cleric in Taiwan in both PVE and PVP and you just found my Min-Max Cleric Guide. On Global we managed to hit 2,2k Gearscore in 3 Days and reached Rank 1 in 1vs1 Arena and Abyss simultaenously. Here is going to be your go to source for any High Ranked Cleric Content of Aion 2 Global. Like all my Guides it will be regularly updated after every Patchnotes and everything is self tested or in terms of dps optimization calculated. As always I am offering an unofficial support if you comment below any Youtube Video (topics dont have to match) I will answer your question within 24 hours. Maintaining a Guide of this standard takes a lot of effort, but what doesnt take a lot of effort is giving the Guide a Heart, just 1 click for you but helps me out tremendously.
---------------------------------------------

Socials:
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@MrRosaPonyGaming
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/mrrosapony
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@mrrosapony
Kick: https://kick.com/mrrosapony
Daevion Boards: [Video Guide Link]

New Ariel Boards according to Patch 21.10 have been added.
This System is designed to be fully maxed out at some point, so under the Daevion Board Tab I made you an early game board that is giving max value with least points spend and as requested I updated on a Mid Version so you know better what to fill up afterwards. But you need to understand some general rules when you level your board. You wanna reach the orang

guides.name: Cleric PvP/PvE Heal-Dps Global FR/EU [F2P] - Alwera — marx0310
guides.description:
Билд с Questlog: №4 по популярности у класса (108 лайков), автор marx0310. Стадий: 5 — выберите целевую.

Описание автора:
Scrollez plus bas pour la description en français !

🇪🇳
PvE
While LevelingTry to complete the green quests, sealed dungeons, and fortresses along your way before reaching max level. (You will have a harder time completing this content if you rush straight to max level.)
Collect feathers to reach level 30 at the Monolith and level 20 at the Abyss Monolith.
Upgrade your belt and amulet to Unique (yellow) +0, if possible. (Upgrading them further becomes expensive.)
Once you reach level 45, the goal is to reach 1400 GS to run Vakron and/or Uruguru. Your build will also depend on the equipment you can obtain while farming. This allows you to make the most efficient use of your Odyle Energies. You can also run the previous dungeons if you prefer to take your time!
If you're missing some item level to reach the requirement, you can increase your yellow equipment from +5 to +10 and use lower-grade Mana Stones on certain pieces of equipment.

1600 GS
Complete the Transcendences to obtain Arcana and reach 1900 GS.
Adjust your equipment depending on the loot you get from Vakron, but you can also run Uruguru to fill in the gaps more easily!

1900 GS
Level 2 Transcendences are unlocked, allowing you to obtain better Arcana.

2100 GS
This is where things really start!
Complete the Kromede and Ferocious Conquests to obtain their gear and start upgrading your weapons, armor, and accessories.

2300 GS
Level 3 Transcendences are unlocked, allowing you to obtain even better Arcana.

2600 GS
